plan.by: conductor (in the editor's chat; reviewed by the security sub-agent below)
plan.comment: Cause found: release v0.1.307 (b6f07175, 1 Nov 03:06) reached dev but its tag never did, so every run since computes v0.1.307 again from the newest tag (v0.1.306), writes the same ./version, has nothing to commit and fails; no deploy for about 43 hours. Fix in my lane (.github/**): the next number reads the higher of the newest tag and ./version, so the next run releases v0.1.308. No tag pushed by hand, ./version not written. Gate, push; the next push to dev releases.

pre_review.comment: Diagnosis confirmed; in scope; ./version not hand-written; gate untouched. Conditions: read ./version only if it matches vX.Y.Z; compare with sort -V; keep the empty fallback.
